combo_label: At the Supermarket × Horses & Riding × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Bundle of cotton strings on a long handle, wrung out in a wheeled bucket
Moving belt that carries your shopping towards the till
Any long drawn-out affair today; once, a stark northern tale of feud and outlawry
Hair along the top of the neck, plaited into bobbles before a show
U of iron nailed under the foot, or hung above a door for luck
Anything measuring 14.2 hands or under; also £25 in British slang
Yard visitor with an anvil in the van, rasp in hand and nails in his mouth
Chilled chest where the peas and ice cream live
Mischief-maker bound in a cave beneath a serpent's venom until the last battle
Anybody in the store to buy rather than to sell, however lost they look
Allfather who pledged an eye at Mimir's well and hung nine nights on the world tree
Angular mark cut in stone or bone, carrying spells and the names of the dead
